title: audit detail request.refused
description: detail of audit rows with action request.refused: a write request was refused and its route left no refusal row of its own; written by the request pipeline in a transaction of its own after the route's transaction was rolled back (ADR-063 section 1): the method, the path template of the route (never the path), the answered status and error code; the target is the last path parameter. Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
